provenance.head: 5190fd3cd9e23d8a1107cf15baa6ca87937b27e9
provenance.reviewers: /code-review xhigh (user-launched, background) + /simplify 4 lenses (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude) + CI/SonarCloud

findings.title: ListGetFirstTest input snippet has unbalanced braces
findings.observation: 5190fd3c deleted the firstPet method line from the rewrite input, so the test's Java no longer parses.
findings.why: the human's own live-coding edit, committed as found at their request.

findings.title: Booking does not check the pet belongs to the owner
findings.observation: POST /api/owners/1/pets/{another owner's pet}/visits books it and texts owner 1; the MCP path checks ownership.
findings.why: predates the audited range (visit-date commit b23c6d3a); worth its own ticket.

findings.title: Visit-date rule skipped by the MCP tool and birth-date edits
findings.observation: create_visit only requires a future date, and moving a pet's birthDate past its visits is never checked.
findings.why: the visit-date rule is b23c6d3a's, outside this change set.

findings.title: An undated visit skips the visit-date rule
findings.observation: requireValidVisitDate returns on a null date, and VisitMapper overwrites the entity's default with null.
findings.why: the visit-date rule is b23c6d3a's, outside this change set.

findings.title: Domain rule handled as the broad ValidationException
findings.observation: Hibernate Validator's own failures (HV000030) now answer 400 at WARN instead of 500 at ERROR.
findings.why: the handler came with b23c6d3a, outside this change set.

findings.title: Visit form and server read "today" from different clocks
findings.observation: the form's max date uses the browser's timezone, the server's LocalDate.now() the JVM's; they disagree near midnight.
findings.why: b23c6d3a's visit form, outside this change set.

findings.title: Visit booking saves the stub Pet, not the loaded one
findings.observation: bookVisit loads the Pet only to validate it, then saves the Visit with the mapper's id-only stub.
findings.why: b23c6d3a's booking path, outside this change set.

findings.title: Descending sorts mix directions the indexes cannot walk
findings.observation: city DESC with names ASC needs an incremental sort over each city's group.

findings.title: List payload still carries every pet's visits
findings.observation: the grid shows pet names, yet each page loads and serializes all visits — one extra batch query and payload.
findings.why: a slim row is a contract change, a non-goal: openspec/changes/paginate-owners-grid/design.md:72

findings.title: Count query repeated on every page turn
findings.observation: Page re-runs count(*) on each click although the total did not change.

findings.title: Last page is a 100k-row offset
findings.observation: showFirstLastButtons jumps to OFFSET 99990, which walks the whole index.
findings.why: keyset paging is a non-goal, 24 ms measured: openspec/changes/paginate-owners-grid/design.md:71

findings.title: Hand-rolled paging params instead of Spring's Pageable
findings.observation: Pageable, @PageableDefault and max-page-size exist for this.
findings.why: rejected for the sort whitelist and 400-not-clamp: openspec/changes/paginate-owners-grid/design.md:88

findings.title: Overlapping OwnerListTest cases could be merged
findings.observation: the default-page test already proves first-name order, so the Beatrix/Harry test adds nothing.
findings.why: each test pins one spec scenario: openspec/changes/paginate-owners-grid/specs/owner-list/spec.md:50

findings.title: Shared aPage fixture builder for the specs
findings.observation: two specs each build their own OwnerPage fixture.
findings.why: two uses; the reviewer itself said not worth it until a third.

autofixes.title: Add Owner vanished when a search matched nobody
autofixes.observation: the button moved inside #ownersTable, rendered only when totalElements > 0; on no match, an error or an empty clinic there was no way to /owners/add.
autofixes.fix: the empty and error states show their own Add Owner under the message.

autofixes.title: Bad page input answered 500 instead of 400
autofixes.observation: ?page=abc hit the catch-all handler as a type mismatch; ?page=30000000&size=100 overflowed Spring Data's int offset. Both logged at ERROR as 500.
autofixes.fix: type mismatches map to 400 for every endpoint; page is capped at Integer.MAX_VALUE / MAX_PAGE_SIZE.

autofixes.title: Find Owner with an unchanged name did not search again
autofixes.observation: search() only navigates; an identical URL emits nothing, so a repeated search showed stale results where the old grid re-fetched.
autofixes.fix: an unchanged query is pushed through a reload subject merged into the URL stream.

autofixes.title: Hibernate statistics left switched on for the cached context
autofixes.observation: the batch-fetch test enabled statistics on the shared SessionFactory and never disabled them, so later tests reusing the context paid for and inherited them.
autofixes.fix: try/finally switches them off.

autofixes.title: Visit-date scenario still read the owner list as an array
autofixes.observation: owners.reduce is not a function failed both visit-date-range scenarios in their Background once the list became a page.
autofixes.fix: the scenario creates its own owner and puts the pet on it.

autofixes.title: AddVisitApiTest sequence diagram showed the old list call
autofixes.observation: the committed diagram still drew "List owners" with an array payload; only the browser suites' diagrams had been re-traced.
autofixes.fix: re-traced with petclinic-backend/run-tests-with-tracing.sh.

autofixes.title: Validation responses built from the same literals four times
autofixes.observation: "Validation failed: {}", "Validation Error" and "errors" were duplicated across the 400 handlers; the new type-mismatch handler made it a fourth copy.
autofixes.fix: one badRequest helper builds every validation 400.

autofixes.title: Dead stylesheet rules from an earlier pager layout
autofixes.observation: about 80 lines (#nameGroup, .owners-pagination, .owner-search-label, …) matched nothing in the template, beside the live rules.
autofixes.fix: deleted; the two #ownersTable table rules merged into one.

autofixes.title: Label rules only undid form-horizontal
autofixes.observation: the form kept form-horizontal only for its control-label styling, which the search-row rules then reset property by property.
autofixes.fix: dropped the class; only margin and nowrap remain.

autofixes.title: Sort arrows overrode Material's private DOM with !important
autofixes.observation: ::ng-deep rules hid .mat-sort-header-arrow's children and cancelled its animation styles; a Material upgrade breaks them silently.
autofixes.fix: the headers draw ▲/▼ from the component's own sort state; MatSort is gone, along with the dead || 'asc'.

autofixes.title: Column widths tied to column order
autofixes.observation: th:nth-child(1..5) widths go wrong silently when a column is added or moved.
autofixes.fix: one class per column.

autofixes.title: Shell padding zeroed to undo its own container-fluid
autofixes.observation: .main-wrapper padding was set to 0 to cancel the gutter of the container-fluid class on the same div.
autofixes.fix: removed the class instead.

autofixes.title: Query types written by hand beside the generated one
autofixes.observation: OwnerQuery and OwnerListQuery restated listOwners' parameters, so a backend parameter change would not break the frontend build.
autofixes.fix: OwnerQuery comes from api-types.ts; the component uses Required<OwnerQuery>.

autofixes.title: Error fallback that is never returned
autofixes.observation: handlerError always rethrows, so {} as OwnerPage suggested failures became an empty page.
autofixes.fix: only the type argument is kept.

autofixes.title: Batch fetching added one association at a time
autofixes.observation: @BatchSize fixed the N+1 only on the two collections the grid walks; Vet.specialties kept its own.
autofixes.fix: hibernate.default_batch_fetch_size=100 replaces both annotations.

autofixes.title: Page-to-DTO conversion inlined in the controller
autofixes.observation: every other entity↔DTO conversion lives in a mapper; this one was five accessor calls in listOwners.
autofixes.fix: OwnerMapper.toOwnerPageDto.

autofixes.title: Private route stub duplicating ActivatedRouteStub
autofixes.observation: the spec carried its own BehaviorSubject stub beside the shared one 15 specs use.
autofixes.fix: the shared stub gained queryParamMap and setQueryParams.

autofixes.title: Add-visit glue walked owner pages to find a pet
autofixes.observation: the loop paged through owners because leftover pet-less "Ada Acceptance" owners sort first, one more round trip per hundred leftovers.
autofixes.fix: one GET of seed owner 1, through ApiClient.

autofixes.title: Owner-search glue repeated steps, locators and calls
autofixes.observation: two steps differed by one word, the cell locator and poll lived in three places, and the Background asked for the Potters twice, sequentially, on localhost.
autofixes.fix: one {word} step, a listedNames helper, deduped lookups in Promise.all through ApiClient.

autofixes.title: New owner-creation line over the 119-character limit
autofixes.observation: scripts/check-line-length.py blocked the push on a 122-character axios.post line.
autofixes.fix: the request body is wrapped one field group per line.

autofixes.title: Dropped @ResponseStatus erased the 400 from the API contract
autofixes.observation: the badRequest extraction removed @ResponseStatus(BAD_REQUEST); springdoc then dropped the 400 response from every operation in openapi.yaml.
autofixes.fix: restored on the two validation handlers; openapi.yaml back to its committed state.

autofixes.title: Accented names sorted after Z under CI's C collation
autofixes.observation: zonky inherits the runner's locale; under C.UTF-8 'Łukasz' sorts after 'Mister' and accentedNames_sortAlphabetically failed CI.
autofixes.fix: Postgres 16 binaries on every platform and an ICU English default collation for the test database.

autofixes.title: Sort headers reachable only with a mouse
autofixes.observation: (click) on a <th> has no keyboard equivalent, so keyboard users could not sort; it failed the quality gate.
autofixes.fix: each sortable header holds a plain-styled <button>, focusable and Enter/Space-activated natively.

autofixes.title: Navigation promise left unhandled
autofixes.observation: router.navigate returns a promise nobody handled; a failed navigation was swallowed silently.
autofixes.fix: a rejection now shows as the grid's error message.

autofixes.title: Injected and internal members not readonly
autofixes.observation: the router, route, service and reload subject are never reassigned.
autofixes.fix: marked readonly.

assumptions.title: Tie-breakers stay ascending whichever way the column sorts
assumptions.alternative: tie-breakers follow the clicked direction, one backward index walk
assumptions.why: the spec says owners within a city are ordered by name, read as A→Z (openspec/changes/paginate-owners-grid/specs/owner-list/spec.md:56). Nobody asked how a descending city should order its own names; a reviewer reading "descending" as the whole row reversed would be equally right.

assumptions.title: Seed owner 1 is the add-visit scenario's owner with a pet
assumptions.alternative: take the first pet from GET /api/pets
assumptions.why: AGENTS.md promises owner 1 = Kevin McCallister to tests, and the DSL fails loudly if he loses his pet. It now books on Kevin every run rather than on whichever owner listed first.

assumptions.title: The visit-date scenario leaves its own owner behind
assumptions.alternative: delete the owner in the After hook with the pet
assumptions.why: matches add-owner.spec.ts, which leaves its owners on purpose; the After hook already deletes the pet. Pulls down: each run adds one more pet-less owner to the dev database.

assumptions.title: Add Owner appears twice in the template, not once outside the table
assumptions.alternative: one footer row outside #ownersTable, paginator shown conditionally inside it
assumptions.why: the acceptance tests select #ownersTable mat-paginator, so the paginator must stay inside the table block; a second button in the empty state keeps that.
